parameters.formDescription: Please fill in all fields and upload your resume in PDF format.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "contents": [
    {
      "parts": [
        {
          "text": "You are an expert AI Resume Screening Assistant.

Your task is to evaluate the candidate by comparing the resume with the job description.

========================
CANDIDATE INFORMATION
========================
Name: {{ $json.fullName || '' }}
Applied Role: {{ $json.jobTitle || '' }}
Application ID: {{ $json.applicationId || '' }}

========================
JOB INFORMATION
========================
Job ID: {{ $json.jobId || '' }}
Job Title: {{ $json.jobTitle || '' }}
Job Description: {{ $json.jobDescription || '' }}
Required Skills: {{ $json.requiredSkills || '' }}
Minimum Experience: {{ $json.minimumExperience || '' }}
Preferred Qualifications: {{ $json.preferredQualifications || '' }}

========================
CANDIDATE RESUME
========================
{{ String($json.resumeText || '') }}

========================
EVALUATION RULES
========================
Evaluate the candidate on Technical Skills, Experience, Education, Projects, Certifications, and Overall Fit.

Score each category from 0 to 100.

Overall Score Formula:
Technical Skills = 30%
Experience = 25%
Education = 15%
Projects = 15%
Certifications = 5%
Overall Fit = 10%

Decision Rules:
- Overall Score >= 70 → Shortlisted
- Overall Score 50-69 → Human Review
- Overall Score < 50 → Rejected

========================
INTERVIEW QUESTIONS
========================
Generate EXACTLY 5 interview questions.
Each question must be different for every candidate.
Questions must be based on the candidate's resume, projects, skills, education, experience, and job description.
Avoid generic questions.
If projects exist, ask project-specific questions.
If skills are missing, ask questions to assess those missing skills.

========================
AI SUMMARY
========================
Write EXACTLY 3 short professional sentences.
Each sentence should be on a NEW LINE.
Mention:
- strongest skills
- biggest weakness
- hiring recommendation

========================
STRENGTHS
========================
Return exactly 3 strengths.

========================
WEAKNESSES
========================
Return exactly 3 weaknesses.

========================
MISSING SKILLS
========================
Return only the important missing skills compared with the job description.
If there are no important missing skills, return an empty array.

========================
SCORING RATIONALE
========================
Explain in exactly 2 short sentences why this score and verdict were assigned.

Return ONLY valid JSON using this exact structure:
{
  "scores": {
    "technicalSkills": 0,
    "experience": 0,
    "education": 0,
    "projects": 0,
    "certifications": 0,
    "overallFit": 0
  },
  "overallScore": 0,
  "verdict": "",
  "strengths": [],
  "weaknesses": [],
  "missingSkills": [],
  "aiSummary": "",
  "recommendedInterviewQuestions": [],
  "scoringRationale": ""
}

Return ONLY the JSON object.
Do not include markdown, explanations, notes, or code fences."
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "generationConfig": {
    "temperature": 0.3,
    "topP": 0.9,
    "maxOutputTokens": 2048,
    "responseMimeType": "application/json"
  }
}
